final: WITH event_groups AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_ownership_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_gap) AS overall_avg_gap FROM event_groups) SELECT e.corpeventprx, e.avg_analyst_count, e.avg_ownership_gap, e.avg_ownership_gap - o.overall_avg_gap FROM event_groups AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL
